decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program extends the firm's existing manufacturing and logistics know-how, so management can read its results and refine it easily, though it may later be merged into the broader express line.

The seventy-two-hour delivery relies on the firm's spare-parts and production logistics capabilities and has stayed visible on the website, though its operational demands make consolidation somewhat more likely than for other products.
This multi-model express line has its own page in both years and builds directly on the core door and gate portfolio, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and improve it.
The digital ordering and services platform supports the firm's service-oriented strategy and generates customer data that the firm's in-house development can assimilate, making it a strategic asset.

The fire and smoke protection door draws on the firm's certified safety and engineering expertise and was raised to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment after the separate fire-resistant door was withdrawn.
